_comment: ScanVerdict (RFC-0006) - a signed record of what a guardrail saw. The gateway signs; the detector is named. contentBinding binds the verdict to the exact bytes scanned WITHOUT carrying them, so the record is publishable to an auditor or an insurer. requestBinding is the SAME value the A2A attestation for that call carries, which is what proves the two documents describe one request. scoreMilli/thresholdMilli are integer thousandths because json.dumps(1.0) is "1.0" and JSON.stringify(1.0) is "1", and a float score would break cross-language byte equivalence. signatureValue is a placeholder here; live sign/verify is in warlog-spec-py tests. Generated by warlog_spec.conformance.produce_scan_verdict().
